What To Expect
Realise the validation (hardware, software and functional) on the test bench (automatic or manual) of the computer or electrical/electronic components as part of the complete system
Write / edit test scenarios
Realise ECU configurations and calibrations for the test
Analyze CAN signals
Participate in the elaboration of the rules of the trade in the perimeter of his activity
Check the implementation of the professional rules within the service
Respect the QCD (Quality Costs Terms) benchmarks from the EE architecture validation perimeter
Keep the planning of validations in line with the planning of the projects
Coordinate the convergence of problems discovered on the validation perimeter, as well as used parts and wiring
Create validation reports
Document each error so that it can be reproduced by the supplier
If needed, participate in discussions with the supplier to detail the test scenarios that led to the identification of bugs.
 What You Bring Along
University degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Electronics or similar
Experience in Manual Testing
Relevant mathematical understanding
Experience in at least one of the following areas is a plus: Vector tools CANoe and CANanalyzer, ODIS (Offboard diagnosis information system), microcontrollers, ECU-Test, LIN networks
Experience in MS Office Applications (Excel) English and German language is a plus
Good communication skills.
 What We Offer
Mentoring program and training on-the Job.
Flexible working environment.
Team-oriented work.
Private health insurance with optional medical packages for you and your family.
24 vacation days, increasing to 25 days after 3+ years with us.
Meal tickets and Holiday vouchers.
Bookster and 7Card subscription.
Our offices are located in Bucharest, Sibiu, and Cluj-Napoca
